newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat's Fatah edges Hamas in W Bank student polls.
newsitem.headline: Arafat's Fatah edges Hamas in W Bank student polls.

text.p: Supporters of Palestinian President Yasser Arafat's Fatah movement won student elections in a West Bank Palestinian university seen as a test of strength between the PLO and Islamist groups, university officials said.
"Fatah won the elections," a university spokesman told Reuters on Wednesday.
Fatah, running as the "Jerusalem bloc", won 22 seats on the 51-member assembly of Bir Zeit University, narrowly edging out the Hamas-affiliated Islamic Bloc, which took 20 seats.
Backers of Palestinian leftist groups took eight seats and the militant Islamic Jihad won one.
The victory restores the council to Fatah, which last year lost to Hamas.
Hamas on Monday won student elections at Hebron University.
